desc.en: A person in his dream saw the Holy Prophet (s), very sad and the person ask him the reason of sadness and he said: that during Meraj he saw many believers being led towards hell and the reason was Imaan (faith). His Ummah was very weak in their Imaan and He recommended this Dua for protection of his Ummah and it will help them in the world, after death and also in the Barzak (resurrection). This dua is very helpful for a person who recites it daily between Maghrib and Isha Prayers…
desc.rurdu: Ek shakhs ne Rasoole Khuda (s) ko khwaab mein dekha keh woh bohot ghamgheen hai, to us shakhs ne uski wajah poonchi. Us waqt Rasoole Khuda (s) ne farmaya keh; jab mai Meraj par gaya to maine dekha keh aksariyat Imaan waalo’n ko Jahannam ki taraf le ja rahe hai aur uski wajah kamzor imaan hai. Apni ummat ki hifaazat ke liye is dua ko padhne ke liye farmaya, jo unki madad farmaayegi is duniya mein, marne ke baad aur barzakh mein. Yeh dua mufid hai us shakhs ke liye jo isko rozana namaz-e-Maghrebain ke darmiyan padhe…

trans.en: In the Name of Allah, the most Gracious, the most Merciful.
trans.rurdu: (Shuru karta hu) Allah ke naam se Jo bada maher-baan nehaayat rahem karne waala hai.
trans.urdu: اللہ کے نام سے (شروع کرتا ہوں) جو بڑا مہربا ن نہایت رحم کرنے والا ہے۔

arabic.text: اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ لَا يَسْتَاخِرُوْنَ سَاعَةً وَّلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُوْنَ۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ عِنْدَ سَكَرَاتِ الْمَوْتِ وَعِنْدَ مُفَارِقَةِ الرُّوْحِ وَعِنْدَ مُعَايَنَةِ الْمَوْتِ۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ عِنْدَ حَوْلِ الْمُطَّلَعِ وَعِنْدَ الْوُقُوْفِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ۔

trans.en: My God, Thy protection, Thy protection: on the day when they can neither delay (the event) by a single moment, nor can they hasten it (death). My God, Thy protection, Thy protection at the time of the parting of the soul from the body and in the presence of death. My God, Thy protection, Thy protection at the time of the narration (of our sins) and at the time of our tarrying in front of Thee.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

arabic.text: اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ بِهَوْلِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَشَدَائِدِهَا۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ يَكُوْنُ النَّاسُ كَالْفَرَاشِ الْمَبْثُوْتِ۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوْهٌ وَّتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوْهٌ۔

trans.en: My God, Thy protection, Thy protection from the dread of Doom and its severity. My God, Thy protection, Thy protection When mankind shall swarm like moths (resurrection of mankind). My God, Thy protection, Thy protection On the day when mankind shall stand before Thee, Lord of the worlds. My God, Thy protection, Thy protection on the day when some faces will be bright and some faces will be black.

arabic.text: اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ الْمَرْءُ مِنْ اَخِيْهِ وَاُمِّهِ وَاَبِيْهِ وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَبَنِيْهِ لِكُلِّ اَمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَانٌ يُّغْنِيْهِ۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ يَقُوْمُ الرُّوْحُ وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ صَفَّا لَّا يَتَكَلَمُوْنَ اِلَّا مَنْ اَذِنَ لَهُ الرَّحْمٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا۔

trans.en: My God, Thy protection, Thy protection : When man will flee from his brother, and his mother and his father, and his wife, and his children; for everyone of them they shall be in such anxiety for his own self as will make him oblivious of all other things. My God, Thy protection, Thy protection : on the day when the angles and the spirit shall stand to order, lined up, and none shall be able to speak, except those whom the All-merciful shall permit, and they shall say only what is proper.

arabic.text: اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ يَنْظُرُ الْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُوْلُ الْكَافِرُ يَا لَيْتَنِيْ كُنْتُ تُرَابًا۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ فِيْ يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗ خَمْسِيْنَ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ فَاضْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيْلًا۔

trans.en: My God, Thy protection, Thy protection on the day when man shall see what his hands have sent before him, and the disbeliever shall say, “Would that I were dust.” My God, Thy protection, Thy protection on the day, the duration whereof is equal to fifty thousand years.

arabic.text: اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِيْ مِنْ عَذَابٍ يَّوْمَئذٍ بِبَنِيْهِ وَصَاحِبَتِهٖ وَاَخِيْهِ وَفَصِیْلَتِهِ الَّتِیْ تُؤِیْهِ وَمَنْ فِیْ الْاَرْضِ جَمِیْعًا ثُمَّ یُنَجِّیْهِ كَلَّا اِنَّهَا لَظٰی نَزَّاعَۃً لِّلشَّوٰی۔

trans.en: My God, Thy protection, Thy protection : on the day when the sinner would wish that he could reason himself from the torment of that day by substituting for himself his son, or wife, or brother, or the kindred with whom he passed his life or all the inhabitants of the earth put together, and thus save himself, But no! Verily it is a flaming fire, and it will scorch the skin.

arabic.text: اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْ تَرْجُفُ الرَّاجِفَةُ تَتْبَعُهَا الرَّادِفَةُ قُلُوْبٌ يَّوْمَئِذٍ وَّاجِفَةُ اَبْصَارُهَا خَاشِعَةٌ۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ يَقُوْلُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ لَا بُشْرٰى يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِيْنَ وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُوْرًا۔

trans.en: My God, Thy protection, Thy protection on the day when the earth quake will shake the earth, and its sequel (another earthquake) shall follow it. Hearts on that day shall palpitate, and eyes shall be down caste. My God, Thy protection, Thy protection on the day when the angels shall say: “There is no good news today for the sinners” And “Be gone, away with you”

arabic.text: اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ يَعُضُ الظَّالِمُ عَلٰى يَدَيْهِ وَيَقُوْلُ يَا لَيْتَنِيْ اتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ الرَّسُوْلِ سَبِيْلًا يَا وَيْلَتٰي لَمْ اَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيْلًا۔ اِلٰهِيْ اَلْاَمَانُ اَلْاَمَانُ يَوْمَ لَا یَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَّلَا بَنُوْنَ اِلَّا مَنْ اَتَی اللهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِیْمٍ بِرَحْمَتِكَ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ۔

trans.en: My God, Thy protection, Thy protection on the day when the wrongdoer shall bite his own hands and say “Ah! Would that I had chosen a way of life with the prophet; also for me! Ah! Would that I had not taken so and so for a friend. My God, Thy protection, Thy protection : on the day when neither wealth nor sons shall avail any man, except one who comes to God with a pure man, except one who comes to God with a pure heart by Thy mercy, O most Merciful of all.

arabic.text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْمَوْ جُوْدُ فِیْ كُلِّ زَمَانٍ۔ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْمَعْبُوْدُ فِیْ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ۔ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ الْمَعْرُوْفُ بِاِحْسَانٍ۔ لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللهُ اَلُاَمَانُ یَا دَائِمَ الْمَعْرُوْفِ یَا قَدِیْمَ الْاِحْسَانِ یَا هَادِیَ الْمُضِلِّیْنَ اِیَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَاِیَّاكَ نَسْتَعِیْنُ یَا غَفُوْرُ یَا غَفَّارُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ یَا اَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِیْنَ وَصَلَّی اللهُ عَلٰی مُحَمَّدٍ وَّاٰلِهٖ اَجْمَعِیْنَ۔

trans.en: There is no god except Allah, who is present at all times. There is no god except Allah, who is worshipped in every place. There is no god except Allah, who is known by His Kindness. There is no god except ALLAH. Thy protection, Thy protection, O Eternally Good, O Anciently Kind, O Guide of those who go astray. Thee (alone we worship, and Thee (alone) we ask for help. O Forgiver, O All (forgiving). By Thy mercy, O Most Merciful of all; Bless Mohammed and his progeny, all of them.

arabic.text: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَّآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ۔

lines.rarabic: ALLAHUMMA SWALLE ALAA MUHAMMADIW WA AALE MUHAMMADIN

trans.en: Allah’s (s.w.t) choicest blessings be upon Mohammed and his holy progeny.
trans.rurdu: Parwardigaar Tu rehmat naazil farma Hazrat Muhammad (s.a.w.a) aur unki Aal (a.s) par.
trans.urdu: اے معبود! رحمت نازل فرما حضرت محمدؐ اور انکی آل ؑپر۔
